title: Orthogonal projection onto a 2-plane in an orthonormal frame
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let Q ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with finrank Q = 2, and let a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a,e⟩ = 0. Let π := Q.starProjection be the orthogonal projection of ℝ^P onto Q. Then for every y ∈ ℝ^P, πy = ⟨y,a⟩a + ⟨y,e⟩e and |πy|² = ⟨y,a⟩² + ⟨y,e⟩².
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → ∀ y : Euclid P, Q.starProjection y = inner ℝ y a • a + inner ℝ y e • e ∧ ‖Q.starProjection y‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ y a ^ 2 + inner ℝ y e ^ 2
